preciousMetals.title: Precious metals
preciousMetals.subtitle: Track physical gold, silver, and platinum, purchase lots, sales, and spot estimates.

empty.title: Start with your physical gold, silver, or platinum
empty.description: Add a coin, bar, or round and record what you own. Purchase costs can stay unknown.

provider.configured: Automatic prices: {provider}. Refreshes are cached for {hours} hours.
provider.manual: Automatic price updates are disabled. Add a manual quote to value your holdings.
provider.cached: Using the latest cached market prices.
provider.unconfigured: Automatic price updates are disabled. Manual quotes remain available.

notice.spot: Spot estimates value fine metal only. They exclude collectible premiums and do not guarantee a resale price.
notice.cash: Recording a lot or sale creates no bank transaction and is not a budget expense. Record the cash movement separately if needed, then link an existing matching transaction.
notice.fifo: Sales use the oldest purchase lots first (FIFO). Cost and gains are tracking estimates, not tax advice.
notice.unknown: Some purchase costs are unknown. Known cost is shown separately; a full cost basis and gain cannot be calculated.
notice.immutable: Metal, physical specifications, and currency cannot be changed after creation.
notice.manual: A manual quote selects manual pricing for this holding. Its as-of date controls when it can be used in valuation history.

fields.name: Holding name
fields.formPlaceholder: Choose a coin, bar, or round
fields.purityHint: For gross weight, fine metal weight is gross weight × purity. Fine weight already represents pure metal.
fields.openingHint: Use an opening lot for metal you already own. It does not move cash.
fields.costHint: Include purchase premiums, taxes, shipping, and fees in the total.
fields.proceedsHint: Enter the total received after selling fees.

events.title: Activity
events.empty: No activity yet. Record an opening lot or a purchase.

lots.title: Purchase lots
lots.empty: Purchase lots appear after an opening lot or purchase.

valuation.title: Valuation
valuation.stale: The latest quote is more than 72 hours old.
valuation.missingFx: A required exchange rate is unavailable. No estimated value is included until a rate is available.

quotes.title: Quote history
quotes.empty: No quotes yet. Add a manual quote or use automatic prices.

link.title: Link an existing cash transaction
link.description: Choose a matching expense for a purchase or income for a sale. Linking does not move cash or create another transaction.
link.direction: Choose an expense for a purchase or income for a sale.
link.currency: The cash transaction must use the holding currency.
link.amount: The cash transaction amount must match this entry's total.
link.planned: Choose an actual transaction, not a planned one.
link.unknownAmount: Enter a known total before linking a cash transaction.
link.opening: Opening lots cannot be linked to cash transactions.
link.transfer: Choose a transaction that is not already a transfer.
